**Decision date:** 11 March 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 May 2025  
**Motion:** That the bar operate from 18:00 to 23:00 on Friday evenings and from 12:00 to 23:00 on Saturdays and Sundays during the summer season, with the duty manager authorised to close earlier if trade is quiet.  
**Vote:** 6 in favour, 2 abstentions.  
**Notes:** The change is intended to reduce staffing costs on low-traffic evenings. The Social Committee will review actual opening hours at the end of August and report back to the Board in September.  
**Status:** Current.

---

---

**BD-2025-008** — Memorial Bench Installation (North Fields)  
**Decision date:** 8 April 2025  
**Effective date:** Immediate  
**Motion:** That the Board accept the donation of a memorial bench from the family of the late Mr Ronald Pike, to be installed adjacent to the N. Fields practice nets, and that the club cover the cost of a concrete base.  
**Vote:** 8 in favour, 0 against.  
**Notes:** The bench is to be installed in late April, subject to ground conditions. A small plaque will be added. The family has been informed that the bench will remain in place for a minimum of ten years.  
**Status:** Current.

documents.content:
---

**BD-2025-011** — Clubhouse Kitchen Refurbishment – Stage 1  
**Decision date:** 13 May 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 July 2025  
**Motion:** That the Board approve Stage 1 of the kitchen refurbishment, covering replacement of the floor, work surfaces, and the installation of a new commercial dishwasher, at a total cost not exceeding £11,000.  
**Vote:** 6 in favour, 2 against.  
**Notes:** Stage 1 is the first part of a two-stage project. Stage 2 (new cooking equipment and ventilation) will be considered by the Board in the autumn, subject to the club's financial position. The Social Committee will manage the project and will keep the bar running throughout the works. The kitchen will be closed for two weeks in July.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-012** — Safeguarding Policy Update  
**Decision date:** 13 May 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 June 2025  
**Motion:** That the Board adopt the updated Safeguarding Policy, as circulated with the agenda, and that all coaches, volunteers, and committee members in regulated roles complete the refreshed online training module by 31 August 2025.  
**Vote:** 8 in favour, 0 against.  
**Notes:** The update reflects recent changes to statutory guidance. The Welfare Officer will hold two drop-in sessions in June for anyone needing help with the online system. A record of completed training will be kept by the Club Secretary.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-013** — Increase in Junior Match Fees  
**Decision date:** 10 June 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 September 2025  
**Motion:** That the junior match fee be increased from £2.00 to £2.50 per match, with no change to the annual junior subscription.  
**Vote:** 5 in favour, 3 against.  
**Notes:** The increase is intended to cover the rising cost of match balls and umpire expenses. The Junior Section Chair reported that most parents had been consulted informally and were broadly supportive. The fee will be reviewed again in early 2026.  
**Status:** Current.

Daniel O'Brien appointed role Head Groundsperson. Record status: current.

---

**BD-2025-014** — Lease of Grounds Equipment Store (N. Fields)  
**Decision date:** 10 June 2025  
**Effective date:** Immediate  
**Motion:** That the Board agree to let the small store adjacent to the N. Fields car park to the club's grounds team for storage of machinery and materials, on a rolling licence terminable on one month's notice.  
**Vote:** 8 in favour, 0 against.  
**Notes:** The store has been used informally for some time. The licence formalises the arrangement and clarifies that the club is responsible for maintenance of the building. The store is not to be used for any other purpose without Board approval.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-015** — Club Colours – Proposed Change  
**Decision date:** 8 July 2025  
**Effective date:** Not applicable – motion lost  
**Motion:** That the club adopt a revised shade of green for playing shirts, to be phased in over two seasons.  
**Vote:** 3 in favour, 5 against.  
**Notes:** The proposal was brought forward by the Social Committee, who felt the current shade was difficult to distinguish from two local rivals. After discussion, the Board decided that the cost of replacing kit outweighed the benefit. The matter is closed unless a new proposal is brought forward.  
**Status:** Superseded – motion lost.

---

**BD-2025-016** — Appointment of Assistant Groundsperson  
**Decision date:** 8 July 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 August 2025  
**Motion:** That the Board appoint Mrs Helen Carter to the post of Assistant Groundsperson, on a casual basis, to support the Head Groundsperson during the summer months.  
**Vote:** 7 in favour, 1 abstention.  
**Notes:** Helen has relevant experience from her previous role at a local school. The post is for up to 12 hours per week, with hours to be agreed with the Head Groundsperson. The appointment is for the 2025 season only and will be reviewed in September.  
**Status:** Current.

documents.title: Board Decision Log
documents.content:
**BD-2025-017** — Use of Clubhouse Kitchen by Outside Caterers  
**Decision date:** 12 August 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 September 2025  
**Motion:** That the Board permit the clubhouse kitchen to be hired by external caterers for private functions, subject to a hire agreement and a food hygiene inspection.  
**Vote:** 6 in favour, 2 against.  
**Notes:** The Social Committee reported increasing demand for the clubhouse from members' families for weddings and anniversary parties. The kitchen has not previously been let to outside parties. The hire agreement will be drafted by the Treasurer and Secretary, and must include indemnity insurance and a cleaning bond. The kitchen will not be available for external hire during match days or club events.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-018** — Purchase of Additional Training Equipment  
**Decision date:** 12 August 2025  
**Effective date:** Immediate  
**Motion:** That the Board approve the purchase of two mobile goal frames and a set of agility hurdles for use on the N. Fields training area, at a total cost not to exceed £1,850.  
**Vote:** 7 in favour, 1 abstention.  
**Notes:** The Head Coach raised concerns that the existing goal frames are showing signs of rust and are no longer safe for regular use. The new frames are to be stored in the Grounds Equipment Store when not in use. The Treasurer confirmed that funds are available within the current equipment budget line.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-019** — Pavilion Roof Repair – Tender Acceptance  
**Decision date:** 9 September 2025  
**Effective date:** Immediate  
**Motion:** That the Board accept the tender from J. W. Hartley & Son for the repair of the pavilion roof, at a cost of £4,320, and authorise the work to commence in October.  
**Vote:** 8 in favour, 0 against.  
**Notes:** Three tenders were received. The Hartley tender was the lowest and their previous work at the club was satisfactory. The repair is to be completed before the start of the winter season. The pavilion will remain open during the works, with access to the changing rooms maintained.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-020** — Amendment to Social Committee Constitution  
**Decision date:** 9 September 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 October 2025  
**Motion:** That the Board approve the amendment to the Social Committee constitution to allow non-members to serve as committee members, provided the Chair and Treasurer remain club members.  
**Vote:** 5 in favour, 3 against.  
**Notes:** The amendment was proposed to widen the pool of volunteers, particularly for bar and event management roles. Concerns were raised about continuity and club knowledge, but the majority felt the safeguards were sufficient. The amended constitution is to be circulated to all committee members.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-021** — Junior Section Registration Fee  
**Decision date:** 14 October 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 January 2026  
**Motion:** That the Board set the junior registration fee for the 2026 season at £45 per child, with a family cap of £120 for three or more siblings.  
**Vote:** 6 in favour, 2 abstentions.  
**Notes:** The fee has been held at £40 for the past two seasons. The increase is to cover the rising cost of insurance and pitch maintenance. The family cap is intended to encourage sibling participation. The fee includes a training shirt but not the match kit.  
**Status:** Current.

---

**BD-2025-022** — Floodlight Replacement (N. Fields)  
**Decision date:** 14 October 2025  
**Effective date:** Immediate  
**Motion:** That the Board approve the replacement of the floodlighting system on the N. Fields training pitch, using a grant previously awarded by the County Sports Partnership, with any shortfall met from club reserves.  
**Vote:** 8 in favour, 0 against.  
**Notes:** The existing floodlights have been unreliable for two seasons and two of the columns are beyond economical repair. The grant covers 60% of the cost. The work is scheduled for late spring 2026 to avoid disrupting the playing season. The Head Groundsperson is to liaise with the contractor regarding the protection of the pitch surface.  
**Status:** Current.
